name: Lake Rickabear Day Camp
operator_name: Girl Scouts of Northern New Jersey
description_short: Girl Scout day camp on a 332 acre property with a 40 acre lake in Kinnelon, for girls in kindergarten through grade 9. Campers take Red Cross swim lessons in the lake and go boating, fishing, archery and hiking, with weekly themes, badge specialty weeks and horse programs.
notes: Core program is $545 a week ($435 for the four day Session 1). Badge specialty weeks are $585, horse programs $815 (All About Horses, grades 1 to 3) and $835 (Tack and Trails, grades 4 to 8), and two week CIT sessions $720. Add ons: aftercare $90 a week ($72 for Session 1), Twilight Camp Time $60, Starlight Overnight $100 for grade 3 and up. Campers are grouped as Summer Explorers (K to 1), Discoverers (2 to 3) and Adventurers (4 to 9); rising kindergartners must be 5 by the session. 2027 registration opens December 7, 2026. Lake swim lessons are taught to American Red Cross standards.
